name: Mossback · Blossom style
role: Boss style · Ring 1 Verdant islands (rare) · same abilities
notes: Same rig, bones, animations and hitbox as Mossback; only textures and added boxes change.
A spring form: pale cream fur, a mantle of pink cherry blossom, pale horns, and petal clusters instead of the mushroom. Petals can fall as particles when it charges.
The splinter stays violet and reads well against the pink.
Spawns rarely on Verdant islands (Ring 1) instead of the base look; worth a special title in config.
